mapping_json.fidelity_notes: APPROX: beam_channel geometry maps the rooted fire-stream correctly. §CROSS row 5 rooted-channel law: delivery_notes MUST state rooted — done ('caster is ROOTED during channel'). Fire element confirmed: 'continuous stream of Fire' (dossier). Ailments: DoT-timing law — 'continuous jet of flame' is delivery timing flavor, not an attested burn status. No 'burn' or burn status named in dossier or verify_ledger — §0-UNIVERSAL bars burn emission. Negative kit (canon_corpus.negative=1): identity CONFIRMED, negative_canon CONFIRMED ('Not very strong, sometimes annoying to play'). Eras: classic + lod both CONFIRMED. Inferno's infamous per-frame breakpoint bug (mech_note) is review-book texture. T4 PERSISTENCE_ENGINE_uptime: uptime of the channel IS the loop. Deviation: the rooted-ness and the fire-immune hard wall are the build's defining failure points — approximation captures channel shape but not the mobility-deprivation penalty.
